corrections.text: The article says the Google blog post is dated October 31, 2026 on its page while its metadata gives 2026-10-30, without stating the basis. The page's published_time is 2026-10-31T00:00:05+0100 (23:00 UTC on October 30); the page date follows that +01:00 offset and the 2026-10-30 date is UTC. The Cloud Billing release notes state no time zone for their October 13, 2026 entry, and no cited page explains the gap between October 13 and the blog post.

The Maps comparison contrasts Google's April 22, 2026 post, which listed Maps among the private-preview services, with the general-availability documentation, which lists four services. Google's July 29, 2026 public-preview post, which the article also cites, already listed four services (Gemini API, Agent Platform, Cloud Run, Cloud Run Functions) and not Maps, so Maps was absent from the supported-services list before general availability.
